column6: Worked: d_L Q = -1/2 + 1/6 = -1/3; sector count 3 + 13 + 2 + 1 = 19. Older text: Core Idea "Every prediction has been confirmed" is an unqualified absolute.
Bullet 3 belief "generations interact differently" is partly true (Yukawa couplings are interactions), so the correction did not refute it; narrowed to "feel the gauge forces differently".

Worked: tree-level identity gives q-slash on both sides; q->0 gives Gamma(p,p) = dS^-1/dp; tree Compton with eps->k gives +u-bar gamma u and -u-bar gamma u, sum zero, each nonzero. Older text: Q3 (index 3) answer says Pi(q^2) vanishes at q^2 = 0; wrong, Pi(0) is nonzero (sets Z_3); the pole stays at 0 because Pi is regular there.
Bullet 2 "vertex and self-energy both diverge" was an absolute; the one-loop vertex is UV-finite in Landau gauge. Added "in general, for example in Feynman gauge".

Worked: 5!! = 15 pairings; x,y to z: 4 x 3 = 12, weight 12/4! = 1/2; x-y contracted: 3, weight 3/4! = 1/8. "Symmetry factor 1/2" names 1/S, loose but common usage. Older text: Q0 answer calls any fully contracted term a vacuum bubble; with external points x_i it is a correlation-function term, not a bubble.
